The 'four connected nodes' symbol is a thin flat cyan X lying on the ground, which reads as a stray mark, not a community symbol
The four anchor blocks are small white pucks on grey gravel, nearly invisible
Nothing shows it's a public lot as opposed to an empty one

World rule: Shared civic glyph: name one glyph (four nodes on a ring around a centre node) and require it on the civic lot, the Administrator's insignia and the centrepiece emblem. At the moment each is improvised, and the plus-shaped versions read as a medical cross.
World rule: surfaces.lotRough #bac2ca vs pavement is low contrast; shift to a cooler darker #a3adb6 or add a mandated darker parcel border strip.
elements.fix: Make the anchors 0.6 m square ceramic blocks with chamfered tops and a cyan pip. Join them with flush 0.1 m glowing #66f2df perimeter seams in dashed 1.5 m segments so the whole parcel is outlined. Enlarge the symbol to about 2.2 m across and add a thin glowing ring through the four outer nodes, so it reads as 'many joined around one centre', not a cross. / Stand the symbol up: a 0.8 m dark #36495e projector projects a vertical glowing emblem about 1.8 m across, with four 0.35 m node spheres round a 0.5 m centre sphere joined by 0.12 m bars, in #66f2df. Make the anchors 0.8 m chunky blocks in #8c80b4 with an ivory top. Add a low 0.1 m lavender border strip on the parcel edge.

problems: The round table umbrellas are today's café parasols.
The yellow crate-like object on the roof is unreadable.
The serving hatch is not clearly visible under the tan awning.
elements.fix: Replace the parasols with ivory canopy petals: a single curved shell 1.6 m across on a slim off-centre stem, with a cyan pip. Swap the roof crate for a planted roof garden or refill tank capsules. Open a 1.2 m dark serving hatch with a pale counter lip and cups facing the seating.

problems: The dog itself is today's brown dog, with no future cue on its body.
The hoverball sits on the ground beside the glow ring, so it does not read as hovering.
elements.fix: Add a slim ivory harness (a 0.04 m-thick band round the chest) with one cyan status pip. Float the ball 0.5 m directly above the glowing ring with a small gap, and add a second, fainter ring below it.

problems: The gardener reads well (hat, jacket, seed capsule)
The android courier is mostly ivory and white, the same value as the future pavement, so on the street only its navy legs read
Its parcel is a white box against a white body
World rule: General: add an avoid rule against 'ivory on ivory', meaning every white structure needs a dark #36495e or #8c80b4 base band or aperture to separate it from the pale ground.
elements.fix: Give the android a full #36495e or #8c80b4 cloth wrap-tabard over the torso, darker #36495e joint blocks, and a #efbd66 parcel. Keep the gardener as is.

problems: Reads as a round tower or lighthouse: only about 4 storeys and well short of the 18 m cell, so it doesn't feel like a skyscraper
Window slots are few and the stepped modules barely step
elements.fix: Make it 16–18 m tall with 7–8 stepped cylindrical tiers that alternately offset and shrink. Add continuous dark #36495e window bands on every tier, and planted terraces on 3 tiers in irregular greenery. Give it a crown with a glowing #66f2df ring at the top.

problems: Reads as a vehicle pod, but front and back are ambiguous: one navy canopy covers everything, and the lavender roll-bars make it look like a beetle shell or helmet
The tiny red light is the only direction cue
elements.fix: Split the canopy so the front 40% is a lighter #91d6e4 windscreen sloping to a tapered ivory nose with two glowing #a8fff0 headlights. Keep the rear #36495e. Reduce the roll-bars to one, and add a glowing #66f2df lift pad under each corner with a visible 0.3 m hover gap.
